commitMessage: BROKEN: restored working tree snapshot for investigation
notes: Identified root cause of CUDA Qwen wrong output: MmulHelper::mmulMxM auto-casts FP32 inputs to FP16 (HALF) before cuBLAS on compute >= 6.0. This loses precision causing gdn_qkv_0 to be 7x attenuated vs CPU. Fix: removed FP16 autocast in both mmulMxM and mmulMxV. Build in progress. CPU test passes (token 271 = Paris). CUDA test expected to pass after rebuild.
